target: Use target `nautilus` for all file-manager actions.
description: Manage a seeded Nautilus workspace through visible file-manager outcomes such as navigation, search, hidden-file visibility, bookmarks, and file organization within the workspace.

actions.name: manage_workspace
actions.description: Navigate folders, search, toggle hidden files, and reorganize files inside the seeded Nautilus workspace.

examples.description: Open the alpha project folder and rename the draft plan file
Search for notes and reveal hidden files in the current folder

done_action.description: Return this action when the Nautilus task is fully complete.

tips: Paths are relative to the currently open folder unless they explicitly include parent segments like ../ or a top-level folder name. Use / to refer to the benchmark Home/workspace root when that root is visibly open in the UI.
Keep actions aligned to visible outcomes in the window: current folder, visible entries, search query, bookmark sidebar, and hidden-file visibility.
Use one invoke_function action with sequential operations when a task needs rename/copy/open or bookmark/open as a single short workflow.
